layers.title: Access layer
layers.about: What a client talks to: the SDK, the gRPC and REST front door (Proxy), and who may do what.

layers.title: Coordination (MixCoord)
layers.about: Metadata, scheduling and timestamps. RootCoord, DataCoord, QueryCoord and StreamingCoord are libraries run inside one MixCoord process, over etcd/TiKV metadata and the TSO.

layers.title: Streaming and the WAL
layers.about: The write path: every DML and DDL is a message appended to a per-channel WAL on a StreamingNode, backed by Pulsar, Kafka, RocksMQ or Woodpecker; CDC replicates the same messages to another cluster.

layers.title: Worker nodes
layers.about: The nodes that do the work the coordinators schedule: QueryNode serves sealed segments through shard delegators, DataNode compacts, builds indexes and imports.

layers.title: Execution engine (C++ core)
layers.about: segcore and the C++ libraries under internal/core reached over cgo: segments, the expression engine, the index wrappers, and the external knowhere and tantivy libraries; plus the Go function framework that runs beside it.

layers.title: Storage formats and object storage
layers.about: What lands in the bucket: the binlog format (storage v1), the packed/manifest format (storage v2/v3 through milvus-storage), the PK index SSTs, snapshots, and the object storage clients.

layers.title: Contracts and operations
layers.about: Shared contracts every process agrees on (the public API proto, internal protos, the data model, configuration) and the launcher, observability, extension hooks, tests and tooling.

components.title: Proxy
components.one_line: The stateless front door: validates every request, parses filter expressions into plans, routes DML to the WAL through the streaming client, scatters searches to shard delegators and reduces the results, and caches collection metadata.
evidence: internal/proxy imports internal/distributed/streaming at 15 sites (DML appends go to the WAL, not to a msgstream producer)
internal/proxy/shardclient/look_aside_balancer.go, refined_look_aside_balancer.go: gRPC to shard delegators on QueryNodes
internal/proxy/cgo_util.go:21 #include "segcore/check_vec_index_c.h" (the Proxy links segcore to validate index params)
internal/proxy imports internal/parser/planparserv2 (filter expression grammar) at 12 sites
internal/proxy/metacache: the collection meta cache invalidated by DDL broadcasts

components.title: RESTful API (v1 and v2)
components.one_line: The HTTP/JSON surface served by the Proxy process: v2 handlers and the legacy v1 routes that can now be switched off.
evidence: internal/distributed/proxy/service.go registers the HTTP server beside the gRPC server

components.title: Go SDK (milvusclient)
components.one_line: The official Go client, its own module (github.com/milvus-io/milvus/client/v3): collection, row/column, index, bulkwriter, membership filters and the client-side telemetry heartbeat.
evidence: client/go.mod:13 requires milvus-proto/go-api/v3 (talks to Proxy only through the public API proto)
internal/cdc imports client/v3 (CDC replicates through the SDK); tests/go_client and tests/integration import it at 24 sites

components.title: Authentication, RBAC and row-level security
components.one_line: Who may do what: credential checks and privilege interception in the Proxy, RBAC users/roles/grants stored by RootCoord, row-level policies, and the optional root gate on the management/metrics port.
evidence: internal/util/adminauth: root credential verifier, used by cmd/roles/roles.go:537 and internal/coordinator
internal/rootcoord: RBAC metadata (CreateCredential/OperateUserRole/OperatePrivilege) persisted through internal/metastore

components.title: MixCoord
components.one_line: The single coordinator process: it constructs RootCoord, DataCoord, QueryCoord and StreamingCoord in one address space, shares one session, one metadata cache and one set of DDL/WAL callbacks among them, and serves their combined gRPC API.
evidence: cmd/roles/roles.go:234 runComponent(components.NewMixCoord); there is no NewRootCoord/NewDataCoord/NewQueryCoord/NewIndexCoord role
internal/coordinator/wal_callbacks.go: DDL acknowledgement callbacks registered for the broadcaster
internal/metacache: the shared segment store DataCoord and QueryCoord read in MixCoord mode (design doc 20260917-shared-segment-store.md)
internal/distributed/mixcoord: the gRPC server and the client every other process holds

components.title: RootCoord
components.one_line: The DDL and schema authority inside MixCoord: databases, collections, partitions, aliases, schema evolution, RBAC metadata, quotas; every DDL is broadcast as a WAL message and applied in an ack callback.
evidence: internal/rootcoord/ddl_callbacks_*.go: one callback per DDL message type
internal/rootcoord imports internal/streamingcoord/server at 17 sites (the broadcaster) and pkg/streaming/util/message at 37
internal/rootcoord imports internal/tso at 8 sites (it hosts the global timestamp oracle)

components.title: DataCoord
components.one_line: The segment authority inside MixCoord: segment meta and channel checkpoints, flush, compaction policy and triggers, index build scheduling (the former IndexCoord), import jobs, snapshots, external-table refresh, GC, and the StorageV3 manifest commit framework; it dispatches tasks to DataNodes.
evidence: internal/datacoord/ddl_callbacks_create_index.go, build_index_policy.go: index scheduling lives here; there is no internal/indexcoord
internal/datacoord/task/global_scheduler.go and internal/datacoord/session: task dispatch to DataNodes over gRPC
internal/datacoord imports internal/metastore at 57 sites, internal/storage at 37, internal/storagev2 at 27, internal/util/importutilv2 at 23

components.title: QueryCoord (v2)
components.one_line: The load and placement authority inside MixCoord: replicas and resource groups, segment and channel distribution, balancers, checkers and observers that converge QueryNodes to the target, shard-leader readiness.
evidence: internal/querycoordv2 imports internal/coordinator at 13 sites and internal/distributed/streaming at 14

components.title: StreamingCoord
components.one_line: The WAL authority inside MixCoord: assigns physical channels to StreamingNodes (balancer), and runs the broadcaster through which every DDL is appended to all vchannels with resource-key locking and acknowledgements; also holds the replicate (CDC) configuration.
evidence: internal/streamingcoord imports internal/distributed/streaming at 25 sites and pkg/streaming/util/message at 48
used by internal/rootcoord (17 sites), internal/datacoord (11), internal/querycoordv2 (5), internal/coordinator (9)

components.title: TSO and ID allocation
components.one_line: The hybrid-logical-clock timestamp oracle and the global ID allocator: every write, timetick and MVCC read is ordered by a TSO timestamp.
evidence: internal/tso imported only by internal/rootcoord, internal/allocator and cmd/tools
internal/allocator is imported by DataCoord, DataNode, Proxy, QueryCoord, flushcommon, storage, streamingnode

components.title: Metadata store (etcd / TiKV) and sessions
components.one_line: Catalogs that persist coordinator metadata as KV in etcd or TiKV, the KV clients themselves, and the etcd session registry every process uses for discovery and liveness.
evidence: internal/util/sessionutil: imported by 28 units across every process
go.mod requires etcd client and tikv client; configs/milvus.yaml metastore.type

components.title: StreamingNode
components.one_line: The write path node: owns the WAL of each physical channel, runs the append interceptor chain (timetick, txn, shard/segment assignment, lock, idempotency, partial-update CAS, replicate), keeps growing segments queryable, and flushes them to object storage through RecoveryStorage.
evidence: internal/streamingnode/server/wal/recovery/recovery_storage_impl.go:11-12 imports internal/flushcommon/broker and syncmgr (the flush that used to be DataNode's)
internal/streamingnode/server/viewquery/runner.go:6-7 imports internal/querynodev2/segments and tasks (growing data is queried on the StreamingNode)
internal/streamingnode imports pkg/streaming/walimpls at 16 sites, internal/views at 74, internal/util/segcore at 9

components.title: Streaming client (WAL accessor)
components.one_line: The client every process uses to append to and scan the WAL, broadcast DDL, resolve channel assignment and read replicate state; also adapts a WAL scanner to the legacy msgstream interface for pipelines that still consume one.
evidence: internal/distributed/streaming/msgstream_adaptor.go: delegatorMsgstreamAdaptor implements msgstream.MsgStream over a WAL Scanner
imported by proxy (15 sites), querynodev2 (28), querycoordv2 (14), rootcoord (6), streamingnode (52), cdc, coordinator, flushcommon, pkindex

components.title: WAL message contract
components.one_line: The typed message vocabulary of the streaming system: message types and versions, headers and properties, builders, broadcast and transaction envelopes, chunking of oversized payloads, idempotency keys, CAS headers, encryption.
evidence: imported by streamingnode (183 sites), streamingcoord (48), rootcoord (37), walimpls (40), cdc (8), proxy (11)

components.title: WAL backends (Pulsar, Kafka, RocksMQ, Woodpecker)
components.one_line: The pluggable log implementations under the WAL: each backend registers a builder; the StreamingNode opens one per physical channel.
evidence: pkg/streaming/walimpls/impls/pulsar uses github.com/apache/pulsar-client-go directly; impls/kafka uses confluent-kafka-go directly (not pkg/mq/msgstream)

components.title: msgstream (legacy message stream) and RocksMQ
components.one_line: The pre-streaming message-stream layer: msgstream message types (InsertMsg, DeleteMsg ...), the mq wrappers for Pulsar/Kafka/RocksMQ/Woodpecker, the msgdispatcher, and the embedded RocksMQ server.
evidence: pkg/mq/mqimpl/rocksmq/server started by cmd/roles/roles.go:55 for standalone
internal/proxy/util.go:1267 checkFieldsDataBySchema(..., insertMsg *msgstream.InsertMsg) - still the in-memory insert shape
consumers: flushcommon (12 sites), proxy (9), querynodev2 pipeline (7), rootcoord (4), streamingnode (4)

components.title: CDC (cross-cluster replication)
components.one_line: The replication role: reads the primary cluster's WAL and replays it into a secondary cluster through the SDK, driven by the replicate configuration (switchover, force promote, salvage).
evidence: internal/cdc imports client/v3 (internal/cdc -> client), internal/distributed/streaming and internal/streamingnode/server

components.title: flushcommon (write buffers and sync)
components.one_line: The flush machinery shared by the StreamingNode (its normal home now), DataNode tasks and QueryNode: write buffers, the sync manager that serializes buffers to binlogs/packed files, flowgraph pipeline pieces and a metacache.
evidence: imported by internal/streamingnode (16 sites), internal/datanode (5: syncmgr, io, util), compaction (9), importutilv2 (8), querynodev2 (2), delegator (2)
internal/flushcommon imports internal/storage at 28 sites and internal/storagev2 at 13

components.title: QueryNode (v2)
components.one_line: The read node: loads sealed segments into segcore, runs search/query/retrieve tasks through a grouping scheduler, and hosts shard delegators.
evidence: internal/querynodev2 imports internal/util/segcore at 26 sites (cgo into internal/core)
internal/util/searchutil/scheduler/concurrent_safe_scheduler.go: the grouping scheduler modelled by specs/MergedGroupCancel.tla

components.title: Shard delegator (shard leader)
components.one_line: The per-shard leader on a QueryNode: holds the shard's distribution, applies streamed deletes, prunes segments by PK and scalar stats, fans a request out to worker QueryNodes and reduces their results.
evidence: internal/querynodev2/delegator imports internal/querynodev2 at 13 sites; reached by the Proxy via internal/proxy/shardclient

components.title: Distributed Query Views (QueryView / DataView)
components.one_line: The next query architecture: a coordinator-side view state machine and syncer, DataViews certified by DataCoord, and the two-phase query client that lets StreamingNodes serve incremental data and QueryNodes serve sealed data under a view.
evidence: internal/streamingnode imports internal/views at 74 sites; internal/querynodev2 at 11; internal/datacoord/dataview_adapter.go

components.title: DataNode (task worker, ex IndexNode)
components.one_line: A stateless worker that executes what DataCoord dispatches: compaction, index and stats builds (the former IndexNode), analyze, import and external-table refresh. It no longer consumes the message stream.
evidence: cmd/roles/roles.go:253 runComponent(components.NewDataNode); no IndexNode role exists
no file under internal/datanode imports pkg/mq or pkg/streaming (grep returns none)

components.title: Compaction
components.one_line: Rewriting segments: mix, L0 delete, clustering, sort and TTL compaction; policies and triggers live in DataCoord, the compactors run on DataNodes, and the shared plan/IO code in internal/compaction.
evidence: internal/compaction imported by datacoord (4), datanode (7), flushcommon, snapshotio

components.title: Bulk import
components.one_line: Bulk import of files (parquet, JSON, numpy, CSV, snapshots): readers in importutilv2, jobs and checkers in DataCoord, pre-import/import/reshard tasks on DataNodes (v2 and v3).
evidence: imported by datacoord (23 sites), datanode (7), proxy (5), streamingnode (1)

components.title: External tables
components.one_line: Collections whose data stays in external files: source-file manifests, refresh planning in DataCoord, refresh execution on DataNodes, function outputs computed at refresh.

components.title: Snapshots (backup / restore / export)
components.one_line: Point-in-time collection snapshots: snapshot metadata written to object storage, export to another bucket, restore, and use as an import or external-table source.
evidence: imported by datacoord (11 sites), datanode, importutilv2 (5), storagev2

components.title: segcore (C++ segment engine)
components.one_line: The C++ core of a segment: growing and chunked sealed segments, field data loading through the caching layer, search on growing/sealed data, reduce, JSON stats; reached from Go through internal/util/segcore over cgo.
evidence: internal/util/segcore (16 Go files #include "segcore/*_c.h") is the Go binding
Go callers of the C API: querynodev2/segments (7 files), storagev2/packed (8), util/initcore (5), datanode/index (2), proxy (1)
internal/core/src/CMakeLists.txt:197-200 links tantivy_binding, knowhere, milvus-storage into milvus_core

components.title: Filter expressions and query plans
components.one_line: The expression language end to end: the ANTLR grammar and Go plan parser (planparserv2) that turn a filter string into a planpb plan in the Proxy, and the C++ plan nodes, operators and expression evaluators that run it in segcore.
evidence: pkg/proto/plan.proto: the plan contract between the two halves

components.title: Index library (scalar and vector index wrappers)
components.one_line: The C++ index layer: scalar indexes (sort, bitmap, hybrid, inverted, FM-index, JSON path), the vector index wrapper over knowhere, index file formats and loaders, index builders; plus the Go wrappers that check params and build through cgo.
evidence: internal/util/indexcgowrapper, indexparamcheck, vecindexmgr (Go, cgo into segcore/vector_index_c.h)
internal/core/src/index/vector includes knowhere headers (19 files); index/scalar includes tantivy (19 files)
Go users: datacoord (9 sites), proxy (6), querynodev2 (4), datanode (3)

components.title: knowhere (vector index library, external)
components.one_line: The external vector-search library (zilliztech/knowhere, pinned by commit) behind every ANN index, brute force and index-version range; Milvus reaches it only from C++.
evidence: Go never imports knowhere; it reaches it through internal/util/vecindexmgr and indexparamcheck (cgo)

components.title: tantivy binding and analyzers (Rust)
components.one_line: The Rust crate wrapping tantivy for inverted, text-match and JSON indexes, plus the analyzer pipeline (tokenizers, filters, char filters) exposed to Go for BM25 and text match.
evidence: internal/core/src/index/scalar includes tantivy (19 files); segcore/token_stream_c.cpp, phrase_match_c.cpp
Go users: datanode (3), querynodev2 (3), streamingnode (3), util/function (4)

components.title: Function framework (embedding, rerank, BM25, function chain, PyUDF)
components.one_line: Functions declared on a schema or a search: text embedding providers, BM25 and MinHash, rerankers (RRF, weighted, model), the typed Function Chain and its PyUDF/XGBoost stages.
evidence: imported by proxy (22 sites), querynodev2 (17), streamingnode (11), datanode importers and compactor

components.title: Primary key index (LSM)
components.one_line: A per-vchannel LSM map from primary key to the segment holding the live row: codec, SST format and engine, with a manifest service and GC in DataCoord.
evidence: non-test importers of internal/pkindex are only internal/datacoord (pkindex_service.go:30) and internal/datacoord/pkindex/*; nothing in internal/streamingnode imports it

components.title: Binlog format (storage v1) and the storage codec
components.one_line: The original on-disk format and the Go codec around it: binlog event files with payloads, delta logs, stats/bloom/BM25 logs, insert data, record readers/writers, plus the chunk managers that read and write object storage.
evidence: imported by 38 Go units, including datacoord (37 sites), flushcommon (28), importutilv2 (42), streamingnode (19)

components.title: Packed storage and manifests (storage v2/v3, milvus-storage)
components.one_line: The column-group (packed) format and the versioned manifest that StorageV3 treats as a segment's source of truth, written and read through the external milvus-storage library (LOON) over cgo.
evidence: internal/storagev2/packed (8 Go files cgo into segcore/packed_*_c.h, column_groups_c.h)
imported by 20 Go units, datacoord at 27 sites

components.title: Object storage layer
components.one_line: Clients and options for S3-compatible MinIO/AWS, Azure Blob, GCS (native), Aliyun, Tencent and Huawei, used by both the Go storage code and, separately, the C++ chunk managers.
evidence: imported by internal/storage (7 sites), snapshotio (4), datanode (2), datacoord, util/dependency

components.title: milvus-proto (public API)
components.one_line: The public gRPC API and data model (milvuspb, schemapb, commonpb, msgpb, federpb) shared by the server and every SDK, in a separate repository pinned by go.mod.
evidence: scripts/download_milvus_proto.sh:5-6 fetches the proto sources for the C++ build
imported by nearly every Go unit: proxy (100 files), datacoord (64), client (61), util/function (56)

components.title: Internal protos
components.one_line: The protobuf contracts between Milvus processes and across cgo: coordinator and node RPCs, etcd meta, messages, plan, segcore, index, streaming, view, pkindex, import.
evidence: scripts/generate_proto.sh; CLAUDE.md: regenerate with make generated-proto-without-cpp
internal/core/src/pb: the same protos compiled for C++

components.title: Data model: schema and field types
components.one_line: What a collection is made of: the schema, field and data types (vector types, JSON, Array, Struct/ArrayOfStruct, Geometry, Text, Timestamptz), nullability and defaults, and the helpers every layer uses to read them.
evidence: internal/proxy/fieldvalidator validates incoming rows against it

components.title: Configuration (paramtable)
components.one_line: All configuration: milvus.yaml, environment and etcd sources, dynamic refresh with watchers, and safe projections for diagnostics.
evidence: imported by every Go component (proxy 71 sites, streamingnode 55, datacoord 42)

components.title: Observability (logs, metrics, tracing, web UI, feature usage)
components.one_line: mlog, Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, the event log, the management HTTP server with health and web UI, and feature-usage reporting.
evidence: internal/http/{healthz,webui}; internal/featureusage (used by coordinator, datacoord, proxy, querycoordv2, querynodev2, rootcoord)

components.title: Extension hooks
components.one_line: The in-tree extension points a distribution compiles into the binary: request hooks, QueryNode tuning and other registered extensions.
evidence: imported by datacoord, mixcoord, proxy, proxy/shardclient, querycoordv2, querynodev2, util/searchutil, util/streamingutil

components.title: Launcher (roles, standalone, embedded)
components.one_line: The milvus binary: chooses which roles to run in one process (standalone, cluster role, embedded), initialises the C++ core, starts RocksMQ for standalone, and wires the management HTTP server.
evidence: cmd/roles/roles.go:230-257: Proxy, MixCoord, QueryNode, StreamingNode, DataNode, CDC
cmd/components/*.go: one wrapper per role; cmd/embedded

components.title: Tests (integration, Python, Go, Java, REST)
components.one_line: End-to-end suites outside the unit tests: Go integration tests that run the cluster in-process, the Python pymilvus suites (including chaos and data-integrity E2E), Go/Java/REST clients, Helm test charts.

components.title: Build and developer tooling
components.one_line: Make and CMake/Conan builds, proto and parser generation scripts, deployment assets, the binlog/meta inspection tools and mgit.py, which enforces that feature PRs link a design document.
evidence: Makefile, internal/core/CMakeLists.txt, internal/core/conanfile.py, scripts/*.sh, build/, deployments/
tools/mgit.py:92 is_valid_design_doc_ref matches docs/design-docs/design_docs/*.md; :2837 "Feature PRs require a design document"
